text: to refine this a little bit - the real alternative would be that we name relations to other cards in the cards prose, which would be much simpler but also would require agents to figure it all out every time just from text. With typed links it's a traversable graph that can also be policed deterministically. Maybe in a year models will be so powerful that they'll always get it right from the prompt, but today I have a strong conviction that it wouldn't be possible
